stories.title: Tech barons cozied up to Trump. What will they do in newly blue America?
stories.summary: A Guardian analysis asks how Silicon Valley billionaires who aligned themselves with Donald Trump will respond to a newly Democratic Congress. It argues that voter anger over technology, AI and extreme wealth helped Democrats and could bring tougher political scrutiny for figures including Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos and Mark Zuckerberg.
